description: This file implements encoding and decoding functionalities for the IDNA (Internationalized Domain Names in Applications) standard, including classes for Codec, IncrementalEncoder, IncrementalDecoder, as well as stream writer and reader. It provides the core logic for handling IDNA encoding and decoding, with functions to get codec registration info.

classes.name: Codec
classes.description: Provides encode and decode methods for IDNA data, inheriting from codecs.Codec.

classes.name: IncrementalEncoder
classes.description: Handles incremental encoding of IDNA labels, inheriting from codecs.BufferedIncrementalEncoder.

classes.name: IncrementalDecoder
classes.description: Handles incremental decoding of IDNA labels, inheriting from codecs.BufferedIncrementalDecoder.

classes.name: StreamWriter
classes.description: Stream writer class for IDNA encoding, combining Codec and codecs.StreamWriter.

classes.name: StreamReader
classes.description: Stream reader class for IDNA decoding, combining Codec and codecs.StreamReader.

methods.name: Tuple[bytes,int] encode(self, data: str, errors: str = 'strict')
methods.description: Encodes Unicode data to IDNA byte format.

methods.name: Tuple[str,int] decode(self, data: bytes, errors: str = 'strict')
methods.description: Decodes IDNA byte data back to Unicode.

methods.name: codecs.CodecInfo getregentry()
methods.description: Returns codecs.CodecInfo object registered for 'idna' encoding.

methods.name: Tuple[str,int] _buffer_decode(self, data: str, errors: str, final: bool)
Tuple[str,int] _buffer_encode(self, data: str, errors: str, final: bool)
